يعتليا (form VIII)
# يَعْتَلِيَا (yaʕtaliyā) /jaʕ.ta.li.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَلَى (iʕtalā)
# يُعْتَلَيَا (yuʕtalayā) /juʕ.ta.la.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَلَى (iʕtalā)
